inputs.input: What files does the Dharma Duel project scaffold include?

cases.output:
The Dharma Duel project scaffold includes these files:

main.py - entry point, starts the game loop
game.py - game logic, turn management, battle pile
card.py - Card class definition
ui.py - Pygame rendering, menus, card display
requirements.txt - just pygame
data/cards.json - all 40 card records
README.md - setup and overview
docs/cards.md - how to add new cards

Characters include Buddha, Sariputta, Angulimala, Ananda, Mara, Moggallana, Kassapa, Anuruddha, Upali, Rahula, Devadatta, Siddhartha, Ashoka, and 27 more.

The project uses an iterative v1.0 prototype approach - minimal and playable first, features added in later versions.

fact_file and famous_story fields are on every card. Each card also has archetype, legend status (4 legend cards total), overall_rating, tier (platinum/gold/silver/bronze), and stats: power, wisdom, resolve, influence, transformation, merit.

inputs.input: What characters are included in the Dharma Duel card game?

cases.output:
Dharma Duel includes 40 legendary Buddhist figures across main.py, game.py, card.py, ui.py, with data in cards.json.

Key characters: Buddha, Sariputta, Maha Moggallana, Angulimala, Ananda, Maha Kassapa, Anuruddha, Upali, Rahula, Devadatta, Siddhartha, Anna Kondanna, Emperor Ashoka, Sujata, Amrapali, Kisa Gotami, Queen Mallika, Visakha, Khema, Uppalavanna, Mara and His Retinue, Mara's Daughters, Mara's Army, Devaputra Mara, Sakka, Brahma Sahampati, Vessantara, Mucalinda Naga, King Bimbisara, King Pasenadi, Anathapindika, and more.

Each card has: name, archetype, fact_file (2-3 bullet points of historical information), famous_story (1-2 sentences), and stats for power, wisdom, resolve, influence, transformation, merit.

The deck has 40 cards total. 4 cards have legend status: Buddha, Siddhartha, Angulimala, Vessantara. Cards have tiers: platinum (Buddha only), gold, silver, bronze.

The v1.0 prototype scope was minimal and iterative: load cards, display two, compare stats, basic win/lose.
